channel.title: Pod on DAWN's Blog
channel.description: Recent content in Pod on DAWN's Blog

item.title: K8S Pod Scheduling in Action: Direct Scheduling, Node/Pod Affinities, and Taints & Tolerations Demystified
item.description: An in-depth guide to Kubernetes Pod scheduling strategies and underlying mechanics: covering nodeName scheduler bypass and network port collision troubleshooting, comprehensive testing of Taints (NoSchedule/PreferNoSchedule/NoExecute) with exact and wildcard tolerations, NodeAffinity hard/soft constraints with weight fallback, and hands-on PodAffinity co-location alongside PodAntiAffinity cross-topology mutual exclusion.

item.title: K8S Pod RestartPolicy in Action: Always, OnFailure, Never Behaviors, Exit Code Handling, and CrashLoopBackOff Demystified
item.description: An in-depth hands-on test of Kubernetes Pod restart policies (Always, OnFailure, Never): simulating exit code 137 terminations via docker kill and normal process completions (exit code 0). Deeply analyzes container replacement, pause container lifecycle, K8S RESTARTS counters, CrashLoopBackOff backoff mechanisms, and verifies the default Always behavior.

item.title: K8S Static Pod Lifecycle in Practice: From kubeadm Bootstrap Principles to Control Plane Fault Drills
item.description: A deep dive into the Kubernetes Static Pod working mechanism and kubelet daemon logic, uncovering how kubeadm bootstraps the four core control plane components, hands-on custom static Pod self-healing verification, and control plane apiserver fault injection and recovery drills.
